items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: we had Frank Domanian, Eddie Vinson, Vincent, Illinois Jacquet, Jack Kitt, and myself.

ctx.x: But I heard some records, heard very little of him, there was, but he was pretty good.
Yeah, he lived in Chicago for awhile, but he just passed a couple, well, was it last year? I can't keep up with it all -- it was either last year or the year before last, we buried him here.

And we had Frank Domanian, Eddie Vinson, Vincent, Illinois Jacquet, Jack Kitt, and myself. William Luther Luper was a trombone player, a young boy just come out of Prairie-Prayerview and graduated, and Cootie had come down to catch Milton -- we were under the impression that Milton was, he was the one who told us, that he was gonna take the band and take it to New York, so we had a fire at the Eldorado Ballroom, so we had moved to San Antonio at the Calderman's (UNINTELLIGIBLE) Club there, and Cootie came to San…
